subject.population: Lane-E exact DEAD/LIVE multi-pick divergence microscope

rows.minimalCounterfactual: At each exact divergence point, take the matched LIVE ordinary move instead of the causally fatal DEAD ordinary move.
rows.demand: Current hard facts and global accounting treat the matched moves alike, while the move changes path-resource occupancy and relational must-pass bounds. smallestProbe.question: Does the same frozen path-resource plus relational-bound interface recur on independent exact DEAD/LIVE parents and distinguish causal divergences that current hard prunes do not?

smallestProbe.advanceIf: Independent parents reproduce the same bounded semantic-family distinction under frozen fields, earning a smallest consumer falsifier.
smallestProbe.stopIf: The one-parent interface fails to recur or recurrence has no decision-bearing discordance.

subject.population: EW1 bounded 60-level frozen pricing sample x fresh production reach join

rows.minimalCounterfactual: Offer beam|score=intersectionHarvest|bias=none|width=5000|retention=mechanic-buckets on this level's feature profile (requiredIntersections=6, no mustCross, no portals); production currently offers the same score/width beam only at retention=plain (confirmed via a direct getAttemptConfigs dump), zero attempts at the mechanic-buckets retention variant.
rows.demand: No new semantic operation. The mechanic-bucket-retention beam variant already exists and solves this exact level at 3,063,399 canonical work in EW1 isolation; production's attempts.ts routing for this level's feature profile never includes that retention variant, only the plain-retention sibling at the same score/width.

smallestProbe.question: Does adding the mechanic-buckets retention variant to this level's routed feature-profile branch recover the level at matched total work without regressing other same-branch production-solved levels?
smallestProbe.advanceIf: A matched-work exposure test on the same feature-profile population shows net referee-valid gains with zero same-branch losses.
smallestProbe.stopIf: Exposure produces zero gains or any same-branch solved-level regression.

rows.minimalCounterfactual: Offer any of beam|score=harvestThenFinish|bias=none|width=2000|retention=plain, beam|score=knotBuilder|bias=none|width=2000|retention=plain, or beam|score=mustCrossFirst|bias=none|width=2000|retention=plain on this level's feature profile (requiredIntersections=12, no mustCross, no portals); a direct getAttemptConfigs dump confirms production's routed set for this profile contains zero width=2000 beams other than perimeterSweep (CW/CCW) -- none of the three winning score functions appear at any width.
rows.demand: No new semantic operation. All three beam score functions already exist and each independently solves this exact level in EW1 isolation at 604,008-660,150 canonical work (cheaper than this level's own production work-spent-while-unsolved, 145,012,385). Full T1 census additionally flags this level as singleton-supported (frozenT1SupportClass=production-miss-frozen-t1-solvable, solverCount=1, singleton=true), so the production routing branch for this feature profile omits the level's only known T1-isolated rescuer family entirely.

smallestProbe.question: Does adding one or more of the three missing width=2000 beam score functions to this level's routed feature-profile branch recover the level at matched total work without regressing other same-branch production-solved levels?
smallestProbe.advanceIf: A matched-work exposure test on the same feature-profile population shows net referee-valid gains with zero same-branch losses.
smallestProbe.stopIf: Exposure produces zero gains or any same-branch solved-level regression.

rows.notes: Paired recurrence evidence is CID-0027 (R00118) under the same EW1/production-reach join; both are exact-config routing gaps, not budget/reserve starvation (contrast with the F7 rows above). Bounded EW1-eligible base rate: 2/60 (3.3%) of the frozen pricing sample. productionAttempts=0 confirmed directly from the join for all three candidate actions (never starved/failed attempts). This is the higher-priority of the two rows: it is singleton-T1-supported (the level's only known rescuer family is entirely unrouted here), while CID-0027's missing variant is one of 7 T1-supporting techniques.
